5.0.0-beta.1.title: New Beta Available - 5.0.0-beta.8
5.0.0-beta.1.content:
CST Reader 5.0.0-beta.8 is available. Betas 6 to 8 add an AI Assistant you can ask about the text you are reading — which now remembers your conversations — your choice of AI provider, first-class Windows support on x64 and ARM64, Find in Page, text zoom, a book font per script, and Digital Pāḷi Dictionary roots.

IMPORTANT: coming from Beta 4 or earlier, delete the contents of ~/Library/Application Support/CSTReader/ (Windows: %APPDATA%\CSTReader\) before installing. The search index format changed in Beta 5 and an older index will not be read correctly.

5.0.0-beta.6.title: New Beta Available - 5.0.0-beta.8
5.0.0-beta.6.content:
CST Reader 5.0.0-beta.8 is available. The AI Assistant now remembers your conversations — follow-up questions build on earlier answers, conversations are kept when you quit, and you can keep several by name — and Digital Pāḷi Dictionary entries show the word's root. It also includes Beta 7's fix for the AI Assistant's text in dark mode.

Nothing else to do: install over the top, and your settings, layout, open books and downloaded dictionaries carry across.

5.0.0-beta.8.title: You're Running Beta 8
5.0.0-beta.8.content: Thank you for testing CST Reader Beta 8. AI Assistant conversations are the newest part of the app — reports on those are especially useful. Please report anything you find on GitHub.

announcements.title: CST Reader Beta 8 Released
announcements.content: Beta 8: the AI Assistant now remembers your conversations, and Digital Pāḷi Dictionary entries show the word's root. Coming from Beta 5 or earlier, Betas 6 to 8 also bring the AI Assistant itself, your choice of AI provider, and Windows as a first-class target on x64 and ARM64. From Beta 5, 6 or 7, install over the top; from Beta 4 or earlier, delete the data directory first — see the release notes.
